title: Laughing Young Man Leaning Out Vintage Car Window, 1920s Snapshot Photo
description: A joyful snapshot capturing a well-dressed young man in a dark tailored suit, collared shirt, and patterned tie, leaning out the open window of a late 1920s enclosed sedan or coupe. He rests his crossed forearms on the window frame and laughs heartily at the camera. The dark-lacquered car body shows typical features of late 1920s automotive design, such as an exterior sun visor and a classic steering wheel rim visible inside. A hint of another passenger in a hat can be glimpsed in the rear interior.
